description: Hello, I am writing regarding an extraction flue we installed at the rear of Arch 395, Mentmore Terrace.  Our company, e5 Bakehouse is a bakery which has been operating at Arch 395 since 2011.  We have always extracted through the rear wall of the building into our private backyard.  The flue simply exited the wall with a cover over the face of it.  The sound of the fan in the backyard was noticeable to us when we were sitting outside having a break and so we added an upstand onto the exit.  This measures 3700mm tall x 70 mm wide.
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Within 2 months of the date of this permission, details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority that demonstrate that a noise test has been carried out by BS4142:2014+A12019:&nbsp; The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-7b23093c-7fff-eef4-fbc2-2d39f5bd83d1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA-accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above-required noise levels shall be submitted to the local planning authority in writing for approval within 4 weeks of the date of this permission.
